title: Gastronomia Lanzani
description: Case notes on the Lanzani Bottega & Bistrot site — horizontal filmstrip layout, packaging-driven art direction and a CMS-owned seasonal menu flow
summary: Restaurant site, daily menu rendered from headless CMS, cache-tag invalidation on publish
notes: Art direction comes from the studio’s identity work for the bottega — cream paper base, ink serif display and one powder-blue panel colour lifted straight from their delicatessen packaging, wired as custom properties so the whole filmstrip stays consistent

Desktop runs as one horizontal filmstrip — every section lives on a single translateX track driven by rAF, one easing curve, zero layout work per frame and no per-section scrollbars; below 900px the same markup stacks vertical with no JS layout code at all

The menu layer is their print system re-drawn for screen — display serif at 96px for MENÙ, EVENTI and ORARI, and the PRANZO / CENA / LUNCH / DINNER / APERITIVO pill row generated from the same content list as the print PDFs so the two can never drift apart

items: wordmark and monoline logo lockups as layered SVG
serif display + grotesk label pair, self-hosted WOFF2
packaging palette: cream, ink and one powder blue

notes: Opening hours and contacts are one typed content block — the ORARI table sets tabular figures so the 07:00 → 23:00 rows align at every breakpoint, and phone, Maps and reservation links are plain deep links to Cooperto with no third-party widget on the page

Alessandro signs off copy within days and the team runs seasonal menu swaps through the CMS on their own — the PDF menus are the only files they upload and nothing has come back to the design side since launch
